## Record guidance

Record the exact claim and all provenance fields so that dependent decisions can
be traced to this fact. Derived files that share one origin are not independent
confirmation. Provisional use is permitted only when confidence is high,
verification is time-consuming, and delay would impede progress; record why
each condition is met. An unverified fact cannot support a safety-critical,
consequential, or hard-to-reverse decision, and each such decision remains
blocked until verification.
